## Installation

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/%7B%7Bgithub_account%7D%7D/templateRpackage):

- Using [`remotes`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/):

``` r

## install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("{{github_account}}/templateRpackage")
```

- Or using [`pak`](https://pak.r-lib.org/):

``` r

## install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("{{github_account}}/templateRpackage")
```
